items.difficulty_reason: Two-stage reduction: (2) is reduced to (1) via the presheaf formula for higher pushforwards and flatness of the base-changed projection; (1) is proved by running the smooth-covering spectral sequence twice (stack to algebraic space to scheme) with flatness of the Cech terms keeping the pulled-back modules parasitic, the scheme case being covered by the cited Descent lemma on Cech cohomology of parasitic modules.
